summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting court approval for its acquisition by Equinox Gold Corp. via a plan of arrangement. Orla shareholders receive 1.00 Equinox share and US$0.0001 cash per Orla share. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock merger with nominal cash consideration. Expected close is July 31, 2026; Orla shares will be delisted from TSX and NYSE American. The board recommended the deal and obtained a final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia. What to watch: regulatory clearance and shareholder vote remain key conditions; risk-arb spread reflects deal certainty ahead of closing.
